changes: Tags are JRA- and six digits from one group series; labels print by roll, with a roll log of used, returned, spoiled and reprinted numbers
Fresh, blind counts by area with two initials per line, daily area close by the site manager, a movement freeze and an independent recount
Asset classes with SAP codes, types with stickers, control category and ownership; SAP matching, exceptions and reconciliation for Finance
A transfer moves only step by step: approved by someone else, every item scanned out, every item received
Once approved, a transfer keeps its places, kind, new owner and vendor
An item sent back returns to its own area; whoever marks a repair fixed can't also confirm it
Asset register linked to SAP numbers, with legal owner, operator, cost centre, custodian and four separate states
Places as site, building, floor and area; QR labels; fault reports that become repair jobs with a fix-by time and a full timeline
Store staff confirm a repair before it closes
